chunks: And they say, 'The Fire will not touch us except for a few numbered days.' Say, 'Have you taken a promise from Allah so that Allah will not break His promise?' Or do you say about Allah that which you do not know?
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers claim about the duration of their punishment in Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the specific claim of the Jews (and later Christians) that their divine covenant exempted them from eternal punishment, a view often linked to the concept of *al-Nar* being temporary for the righteous of their community. It serves as a theological rebuttal to those who rely on ancestral tradition or limited knowledge rather than definitive divine revelation, emphasizing that salvation depends on true faith and piety, not merely lineage or temporary absolution.
